ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
In a small bowl, mix sauce ingredients. Refrigerate until serving.
In a shallow bowl, mix bread crumbs, sesame seeds and parsley.
In a separate shallow bowl, mix mayonnaise and seasonings.
Dip chicken in mayonnaise mixture, then in crumb mixture, patting to help coating adhere to all sides.
In a large skillet, heat 2 Tbsp oil over medium-high heat.
Add chicken in batches; cook until chicken is no longer pink, turning occasionally and adding additional oil as needed.
